in_sanskrit.name: Ieisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Music
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ieisha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ieisha is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Goddess of Music'. This name is associated with the divine feminine and is believed to bring harmony and creativity to those who bear it.
